item.title: Responsive Design and Mobile Performance Fixes That Make a Real Difference
item.description: Most "mobile problems" on websites come from a small set of repeat offenders: oversized images, layout jumps, unreadable text, tiny tap targets and too much JavaScript. The good news is that none of them need a full rewrite. You can fix most of them on an existing site, one change at a time.

item.title: I swapped audio tracks mid-movie without a rebuffer. Here is how my 1.17 MB player does it
item.description: Indian releases now ship four or five audio languages on the same stream. Telugu original, Hindi dub, Tamil dub, sometimes Kannada and Malayalam too. The stock players pick one at start, and if you switch, half the time the video re-seeks and re-buffers. So people just stay on the wrong dub.
